Chapter 830: Chapter 27: As if Falling into an Ice Cellar (Please Subscribe)_2

Especially after comprehending the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule Sixfold Realm, nearly a hundred years had passed, during which he contemplated numerous other Pillar-level Fusion Rules, allowing Lin Yuan to advance by leaps and bounds.

“There are eighty-three kinds of Pillar-level Fusion Rules that have reached the Sixfold Realm.”

“Specifically, they include the Life and Death Samsara Rule, the Great Destruction Rule, the Causality Fluctuation Rules, the Spatiotemporal Fissure Rule, the Endless Stars Rule, the Cosmic River Rule, the Void Tide Rule, the Cosmic Rift Rule, the Five Elements Cycle Rule, and the Spatial Collapse Rule…”

The Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule Sixfold Realm belongs to the domain of the most powerful beings.

For the other Pillar-level Rules under this, reaching the Seventh Realm is required to achieve the ultimate level.

Out of the eighty-three Pillar-level Fusion Rules, none have reached the realm of ultimate beings, and all are at the peak of the Sixfold Realm, but their quantity is vast.

...

Even for the most powerful beings, it would probably be very difficult to comprehend so many Pillar-level Fusion Rules at the same time and elevate all to the peak of the Sixfold Realm.

The time of the ultimate beings is still time, and they need to devote more of their cognitive energy to understanding their own paths.

In fact, with Lin Yuan’s comprehension abilities, if he focused on any one Pillar-level Fusion Rule, it would be entirely possible to elevate one or two of them to the Seventh Realm within a hundred years.

However, it wouldn’t be very meaningful, since without comprehending the Spatiotemporal Sixth Realm, elevating a certain Pillar-level Fusion Rule to the Seventh Realm would indeed greatly enhance Lin Yuan’s strength.

But with the basis of already having the Spatiotemporal Sixth Realm, an additional Seventh Realm Pillar-level Fusion Rule? Even if it could enhance Lin Yuan’s strength, the improvement wouldn’t be very significant.

In comparison, comprehending more Pillar-level Fusion Rules at the peak of the Sixfold Realm would be more helpful to Lin Yuan.

It is also in preparation for eventually comprehending the Chaos Rule.

Although he doesn’t know exactly how to comprehend the Chaos Rule, according to the information Lin Yuan has so far, the more rules comprehended, the better.

Without a sufficient number of rules comprehended, one cannot ultimately condense everything, return to the origin, and transform into chaos.

Besides the Pillar-level Fusion Rules, Lin Yuan has comprehended a large number of ordinary Fusion Rules, amounting to hundreds or even thousands.

These ordinary Fusion Rules were basically not intentionally contemplated by Lin Yuan, but rather realized by chance, as a side discovery while studying other Pillar-level Fusion Rules.

“Thinking about it now, my Tenth Rank compared to that of the Ten Thousand Races of the Cosmic Starry Sky’s Tenth Ranks…” Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

For Tenth Rank Evolvers of the Main Universe’s human civilization, as well as those from other Myriad Clans, comprehending one Pillar-level Fusion Rule is an A-grade Tenth Rank, and advancing that Pillar-level Fusion Rule to the Second Realm would allow one to strive for Level Eleven.

But Lin Yuan?

The Second Realm? Not to mention reaching the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule Sixfold Realm, just for the Pillar-level Fusion Rules, there are already eighty-three kinds that have reached the Sixfold Realm.

In terms of pure Rule Comprehension, even those Level Eleven Perfect legendary beings can’t catch up to Lin Yuan.

“My strength has improved a lot now compared to a hundred years ago when I first comprehended the Spatiotemporal Sixth Realm.” Lin Yuan felt good.

The combined power of the many Pillar-level Fusion Rules, each at the peak of the Sixfold Realm, coupled with control over the Spatiotemporal Sixth Realm, exceeds the power of a single Spatiotemporal Sixth Realm.

…

After examining himself.

Lin Yuan also looks towards the Boundless Void.

With Lin Yuan’s current comprehension of space and time, by just concentrating a little, he could sense the brilliant ‘glow’ emanating from all the beings practicing Martial Tao.

“For the past hundred years, the two Primordial Spirits have continually transported numerous Martial Tao cultivators to other worlds, and now the number of Martial Tao cultivators in this Boundless Void has indeed surpassed the Martial Arts Evolutionaries of the Main Universe.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The size of the Main Universe’s human civilization far exceeds the Boundless Void, even the territories of the human civilization alone surpass the Boundless Void by much.

But now the entirety of the Boundless Void is under Lin Yuan’s dominion, and after six hundred years of propagation and development, the number of Martial Tao cultivators surpassing Martial Arts Evolutionaries is not beyond Lin Yuan’s expectations.

Within human civilization’s territory, countless citizens have many choices, such as the other nine supreme evolutionary paths, as well as more suitable paths for their own evolution, and so on.

Sometimes, an evolutionary path that suits oneself is more critical than a more powerful one.

But in the Boundless Void, Martial Tao is the only, the supreme, hence all beings naturally practice Martial Tao if they can, and even if they cannot, they still attempt to practice Martial Tao.

“It’s a pity, there aren’t many high-level Martial Tao cultivators.”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

This is also an inevitable result caused by the rapid development of Martial Tao today.

Any cultivation system takes a long time to produce high-level practitioners; Lin Yuan can only spread Martial Tao wider.

But high-level Martial Tao cultivators? There is too much he cannot intervene in, unless he ceases his own cultivation and personally emerges to enlighten those Martial Tao cultivators.

That would be putting the cart before the horse.

At any time, personal cultivation is the foundation. As for spreading Martial Tao? Essentially it’s also for one’s better cultivation in the future.

“There’s only one year left…”

Lin Yuan pondered, thinking if there was still anything that needed to be wrapped up.

Suddenly.

Just at this moment.

Lin Yuan felt something, a surge of temporal and spatial fluctuations, magnificent and sweeping in all directions.

“Hm?”

A trace of surprise appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

“Has an Evil God stepped into the Tenth Stage?”

After a brief sense, Lin Yuan clearly understood that the Evil God who had stepped into the Tenth Stage was the Child of the Void.
